notes.title: Happy New Year From Kagura Games!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/e3b1afb5dedb48f4b2f69d7fd98a64e0db79ba8c.jpg

Greetings everyone,

The new year is upon us and we want to take a moment to wish everyone a happy new year and thank you for all the support during 2021.

We are very grateful to all of our fans and 2022 will be a big year for us. We hope you are all looking forward to our upcoming game projects and more that will take your breath away!

The wonderful illustration featured at the top of this post is drawn by developer GapTax and features characters from his game RaiOhGar: Asuka and the King of Steel.

Don't forget to also follow us on our Steam Publisher page and check out our Winter Sale 2021 which is live for a few more days. You can find up to 60% off on most of our games during the sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227890/Summer_Memories/

notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/87278ba0a268e8b693fdd875ab7c363e17504d74.png

With the release of Ambrosia by Shimobashira Workshop launching on January 30, we're going to take a look at some of the characters from the game!

Flode

An up-and-coming priestess for the God of Light, Leight. She's kind and caring to a fault and staunchly devoted to her god.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/ef316d225169c51753576a936d72c2b92919092b.png

Volze

Volze is the chairman of Big Bucks Business. There's only one thing he truly cares about: making big bucks. He deals in all kinds of trade going in and out of Cerbes Island, including some that may be... on the more questionable side of things.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/865ce911487c040831581734518ddb475d19c745.png

Noir

Noir is a mysterious being, one with ties to the old faith in Cerbes Island. She has a very playful and teasing personality and seems to wish for Flode to do something for her. But what could it lead to...?

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/c51ca7738a108d5dee54609fa6da90d98e8dacee.png

We hope you are looking forward to Ambrosia that is slated to release on January 30! Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to prepare for the release!
